page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred on the text, with the page number at the top right. No margin notes. A gathering signature "T" at the foot on the left, with the last line of text beside it.

main_text.p: bene suis natis prospexisse credant, si in hoc seculo honesto illos loco collocarint, quàm si ad ministerium templi divini, ad Levitarum Sacerdotumque ordinem, Deo volente illos promoverint. Videmus quanto zelo, quali malè institutæ religionis feruore, sub papatu, quos ex filijs suis habent charissimos, sæpe ad corrupta putidaque monasteria relegent: horum in tantis tenebris, tam sollicitus de Dei cultu, qualem sub Antichristi tyrannide reliquum habere potuerunt animus, excutiat nobis hanc socordiam, ne quando contemptum & neglectum Christi nobis exprobret: si nos minore affectu maximum & augustissimum Dei opus promoverimus. Ne putet se perditurum filium qui Christo illum enutriendum dederit: absentiam illius quod lugeat non erit, quum Spiritu suis præsens, ubique præsenti Deo se suosque precibus commendaturus sit. Multum inquit Apostolus potest oratio hominis iusti efficax: hoc septum sibi circumdat, hoc vallo se munit, quisquis suos Deo adhærere, eumque unum colere, prædicare, & indefinenti studio observare docet. Reponit hic apud Deum thesaurum animæ suæ, qui ipsi futurus est, velut argentum expiationum, quod à filijs Israel da-batur

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The printed hyphen at the line end ("da-") is kept, joined to "batur" on the following line. Printed spellings are kept, including "malè", "charisimos" and "poteft" read as "potest". The mark before "perditurum" and the small marks in the text are blots, not characters, and were left out.
